title: The Burnt Asset
premise: Rafael Crane, a private security contractor haunted by a botched extraction he can barely remember, is guarding a whistleblower when the plane carrying his client vanishes from every tracking system mid-flight — erased by Meridian, the shadowy training network that once shaped Crane himself. As he digs into the disappearance, he discovers Meridian has been laundering power for a cabal preparing to seize control at an upcoming global summit, and that his own missing memories are the key evidence they need destroyed. Betrayed by his firm and hunted by the people who trained him, Crane allies with a disgraced aviation analyst and the client's estranged daughter to reconstruct the flight's final hour. In the end, Crane burns Meridian's archive and exposes the cabal at the summit itself — but only by surrendering the last of his own records, choosing justice outside the law over reclaiming his past.
about_author: A. M. Reyes is the pen name of a former risk consultant who spent a decade writing threat assessments for clients whose names never appeared in print. Reyes now writes thrillers about the machinery of secrecy from an undisclosed location.

chapters.title: The Man Who Doesn't Sleep
chapters.summary: Crane's POV. We meet Rafael Crane on a night shift guarding a paranoid tech executive, establishing his insomnia, his ritual of checking doors twice, and fragments of a memory he can't place — a runway, fire, someone screaming his name. Emotional beat: dread disguised as professionalism.

chapters.title: Client Nobody Trusts
chapters.summary: Crane's POV. His firm assigns him a new principal: Elena Vasquez, a former aviation regulator turned whistleblower who insists she'll be dead within a month. Crane notes her fear is specific, not theatrical. Emotional beat: reluctant curiosity cracking through numbness.

chapters.title: Flight 4471
chapters.summary: Elena's POV. Elena explains what she found: a pattern of flights carrying 'cargo' that never existed, tied to a contractor network called Meridian. She's flying to Geneva to testify before the summit's oversight committee. Emotional beat: terrified resolve.

chapters.title: Gone From the Sky
chapters.summary: Crane's POV. Mid-shift, every feed showing Flight 4471 goes blank — radar, transponder, booking manifests, even Elena's boarding record. The plane was airborne ninety seconds ago. Emotional beat: vertigo; reality editing itself.

chapters.title: What the Manifest Forgot
chapters.summary: Analyst Priya Nair's POV. Priya, a disgraced flight-data analyst, notices the same erasure from the outside and finds one cached telemetry fragment suggesting the plane landed, not crashed. Emotional beat: obsessive hope.

chapters.title: The Firm's Quiet Word
chapters.summary: Crane's POV. Crane's employer orders him off the case and hands him a generous severance — signed by a name he half-recognizes from his own buried past. Emotional beat: the chill of realizing he was owned long before today.

chapters.title: Daughter of the Vanished
chapters.summary: Sofia Vasquez's POV. Sofia, Elena's estranged daughter, arrives demanding answers and finds her mother's apartment professionally sterilized overnight. Emotional beat: grief sharpening into anger.

chapters.title: Meridian
chapters.summary: Crane's POV. Following the signature on his severance, Crane uncovers Meridian: a training network that manufactures deniable operators — and a personnel file with his own face, marked 'asset, burnt.' Emotional beat: identity unraveling.

chapters.title: The Runway He Remembers
chapters.summary: Crane's POV, fragmented flashbacks. A suppressed memory surfaces: years ago, Crane trained at a Meridian facility where a test flight ended in fire, and he was made to forget it. Emotional beat: horror at being both victim and instrument.

chapters.title: Alliance of the Erased
chapters.summary: Priya's POV. Priya and Crane cross paths chasing the same telemetry cache; after mutual suspicion, they pool resources. Sofia joins them. Emotional beat: fragile trust among people built to trust no one.

chapters.title: Landed Somewhere
chapters.summary: Priya's POV. The team triangulates the cached data: Flight 4471 diverted to a decommissioned airfield in the Carpathian foothills — a Meridian black site. Emotional beat: the map becoming real and terrible.

chapters.title: Doors That Open Inward
chapters.summary: Crane's POV. Crane infiltrates the airfield posing as a returning asset. He finds hangars converted into holding facilities and proof passengers were transferred, alive. Emotional beat: hope weaponized against him.

chapters.title: The Handler's Smile
chapters.summary: Antagonist POV — Marcus Hale, Meridian's operations director. Hale recognizes Crane, lets him leave, and reports that the burnt asset is activating exactly as designed. Emotional beat: elegant menace; the trap has walls made of Crane's own history.

chapters.title: What They Trained Me For
chapters.summary: Crane's POV. Crane realizes his insomnia, his instincts, even his guilt were engineered — Meridian keeps its assets loyal through manufactured trauma. Emotional beat: rage turning inward, then outward.

chapters.title: Passenger Nine
chapters.summary: Sofia's POV. Sofia decodes her mother's hidden files and finds Elena wasn't just a witness — she was Passenger Nine on an earlier ghost flight, released as bait. Emotional beat: betrayal and love colliding.

chapters.title: The Summit Clock
chapters.summary: Priya's POV. Eighteen days until the Geneva summit, where the cabal intends to ratify a privatized security charter that would legalize everything Meridian does. Emotional beat: ticking pressure.

chapters.title: Safehouse Arithmetic
chapters.summary: Crane's POV. A Meridian kill team hits their safehouse; Crane's training saves them but costs a neighbor's life. Emotional beat: guilt re-forged into purpose.

chapters.title: Reading the Burn File
chapters.summary: Crane's POV. Crane obtains his full Meridian file: the incident, the wipe, and a clause — assets who remember are terminated. He remembers anyway. Emotional beat: quiet, irreversible defiance.

chapters.title: Hale's Offer
chapters.summary: Hale's POV. Hale meets Crane openly, offering restoration: his memories curated, his record cleaned, a seat inside — if he delivers Elena and the data. Emotional beat: temptation wearing a familiar face.

chapters.title: The Archive Beneath
chapters.summary: Priya's POV. Priya locates Meridian's master archive: a cold-storage vault under a Swiss data sanctuary, holding every ghost flight, every wiped operator, every summit bribe. Emotional beat: awe at the scale of the machine.

chapters.title: Halfway to Geneva
chapters.summary: Sofia's POV. En route to Switzerland, the team survives a staged train accident meant to look like terrorism. Emotional beat: the cost of moving becomes undeniable.

chapters.title: Inside the Sanctuary
chapters.summary: Crane's POV. Crane scouts the vault using credentials from his own file and discovers a live feed: Elena, alive, held as insurance until the vote concludes. Emotional beat: relief curdling into strategy.

chapters.title: The Cabal at Dinner
chapters.summary: Hale's POV. At a pre-summit dinner, Hale's masters debate whether Crane is an asset or a liability; Hale defends him — too well. Emotional beat: the handler's own leash tightening.

chapters.title: What Memory Is Worth
chapters.summary: Crane's POV. Crane confronts the truth that destroying the archive destroys his only chance to ever know himself fully. He begins planning the burn anyway. Emotional beat: mourning oneself in advance.

chapters.title: Priya's Line
chapters.summary: Priya's POV. Priya discovers the archive also contains exculpatory data that could restore her ruined career — if extracted before the burn. Emotional beat: self-interest wrestling with solidarity.

chapters.title: The Vote Moves Up
chapters.summary: Sofia's POV. The cabal accelerates the summit vote to forty-eight hours, collapsing everyone's timeline. Emotional beat: panic compressed into clarity.

chapters.title: Extraction Interrupted
chapters.summary: Crane's POV. The team attempts Elena's rescue from the vault complex; it partially succeeds — they get her out, but trip a lockdown that seals the archive behind biometric gates only Meridian principals can open. Emotional beat: victory with a hook in it.

chapters.title: Elena's Testimony
chapters.summary: Elena's POV. Recovering, Elena reveals the final piece: the archive requires two keys — a principal's biometrics and a burnt asset's original baseline scan. Crane is the second key. Emotional beat: destiny as design.

chapters.title: Turning the Asset
chapters.summary: Crane's POV. Crane decides to walk back into Meridian voluntarily, letting Hale believe the offer worked. Emotional beat: cold calm; the sleeper chooses which side wakes.

chapters.title: The Long Con
chapters.summary: Hale's POV. Hale parades Crane through Meridian's inner circle, vouching for him, unaware Crane is mapping exits, guards, and the vault's fail-safes. Emotional beat: dramatic irony at knife's edge.

chapters.title: Baseline
chapters.summary: Crane's POV. In the vault antechamber, Crane gives his baseline scan — and in doing so, briefly sees his unedited original memories on screen: the fire, the screams, and the fact that he once tried to stop it. Emotional beat: grief and pride entwined.

chapters.title: Summit Eve
chapters.summary: Multiple POVs interwoven. The team positions itself: Priya with broadcast access, Sofia inside the hall with delegates' dossiers, Elena ready to testify, Crane inside Meridian. Emotional beat: held breath before the plunge.

chapters.title: The Vote Begins
chapters.summary: Sofia's POV. The charter vote opens; Sofia begins leaking dossier contents to delegates' screens mid-session, sowing visible doubt. Emotional beat: small acts scaling into rupture.

chapters.title: Burn Protocol
chapters.summary: Crane's POV. Crane triggers the archive burn from inside, using his key as the vault seals — trapping himself with the burning servers and arriving kill teams. Emotional beat: sacrifice accepted without ceremony.

chapters.title: Hale Unbound
chapters.summary: Hale's POV. With the archive dying, Hale's leverage evaporates; he tries to kill Crane in the collapsing vault, and their fight becomes a war between what each was trained to be. Emotional beat: fury stripped to essence.

chapters.title: Fire Answers Fire
chapters.summary: Crane's POV. Crane defeats Hale not with technique but with the truth — speaking the burned memory aloud, breaking the conditioning. He escapes as the archive melts. Emotional beat: liberation through remembered pain.

chapters.title: Testimony
chapters.summary: Elena's POV. With the archive's mirrored index Priya salvaged, Elena testifies before the summit; the charter collapses, and delegates flee the chamber as warrants begin. Emotional beat: justice arriving loud and public.

chapters.title: The Empty File
chapters.summary: Crane's POV. In the aftermath, Crane finds his own records gone — burned with everything else. He will never recover his past. Emotional beat: loss transfigured into freedom.

chapters.title: What Sleeps Now
chapters.summary: Crane's POV. Weeks later, Crane sleeps through the night for the first time since the incident, in a safehouse with Priya and Sofia planning to help other burnt assets surface. Emotional beat: earned peace, guarded but real.

chapters.title: Undisclosed Location
chapters.summary: Epilogue, author-adjacent omniscient close. A new ghost flight appears in a corner of the world's data — smaller, cruder, already noticed. Somewhere, Crane's phone lights up. Emotional beat: vigilance as inheritance; the watch continues.
